t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Use the gnome colour to figure out which ones are worth more value, however these change over time. Use the 1x multiplier rounds to figure out the best strategy and the 5x multiplier rounds when you are sure of which gnome to use

vb_textbox.text: Use the 1x multiplier rounds to try and determine which gnome has the higher value. Remember the colours in your head. If you see the value start to decline, use a 1x multiplier round to check if the other colour is giving better results. Use the 5x multiplier rounds for the colours which you know are giving better results
